item.tib: rig 'dzin gsang sgrub kyi me mchod tshad med myur mgyogs kyi phyag bzhes rig pa'i sgron me
item.coloph: de ltar sbyin sreg tshad med myur mgyogs kyi phyag bzhes rig pa'i sgron me zhes bya ba 'di yang gdong rigs kyi stag btsun g.yung drung ye shes kyis bskul ngor/ rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal gyis thugs spral ri bo'i mdun zhol g.yung drung gling gi yang dben du spel ba/ yi ge pa ni nye gnas tshe dbang rgyal mtshan gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel//

item.coloph: de ltar sbyin bsregs tshad med myur mgyogs kyi phyag bzhes rig pa'i sgron me bya ba 'di yang gdong rigs kyi stag btsun g.yung drung ye shes kyi bskul ngor/ rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal gyi (gyis) thugs sprul ri bo'i mdun zhol g.yung drung gling gi yang dben du spel ba/ yi ge pa ni nye gnas tshedabang rgyal mtshan gyis bgyis pas dge legs su gyur cig/
